title: Scenario-Based AI Dialogue
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting scenario-based AI dialogue to a labeled three-move dialogue transcript (SET CONTEXT, NARROW, STRESS-TEST) with an embedded accept/reject note, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Plan and label a three-move scenario dialogue (SET CONTEXT, NARROW, STRESS-TEST) so each turn changes exactly one thing.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Log at least one accepted and one rejected AI suggestion inside the labeled dialogue transcript.
Attribute each change in the AI's output to the labeled turn that caused it.
